provenance: Original benchmark prompts and most schematics authored for CircuitMind Eval. Solutions are analytically derived and should receive independent EE review before being described as expert-verified.
units: SI units. CM004 uses kΩ and mA. All other tasks use Ω, V, A, W.
model_input_policy: Send each question and its corresponding image only. Never expose ground_truth.json to the evaluated model.
